ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Since the line $y=2x$ passes through point A, \\
hence $-2=2m$, solving yields: $m=-1$. \\
As known from the graph, the solution set of $2x>kx+b$ is to the right side of point A, that is, $\boxed{x>-1}$.
